shape: nobody talks about a small, true feeling everyone has had

slides.text: nobody talks about the cold floor at 6 am greeting your bare feet, so you smile before the day asks for anything

caption:
the kitchen lights flicker, but the morning still feels like a small win
i notice the quiet when the coffee brews slower than my thoughts
send this to the friend who always leaves a spare pen on your desk

#selflovequotes #bekindtoyourself #hardweek
